# OMP NInfer

> Durable local inference for coding agents: the qualified local inference appliance for
> Oh My Pi. Your coding session should survive the process. Oh My Pi (coding-agent client) →
> OMP NInfer (qualified appliance and release layer) → NInfer (inference engine) → Qwen3.8 27B
> (served model). Community project; not affiliated with or endorsed by Oh My Pi, Qwen, or
> NVIDIA.

Qualified on RTX 5090 · 4090 · 3090 — **v0.17.0** (published 2026-11-10, GitHub Latest), stock
**Oh My Pi 18.18.6** (`9058ab9d`). The 0.x series supports only the latest published release and its
exact manifest and profiles.
- **RTX 5090 container lane:** Windows 11 + Docker Desktop/WSL2 on loopback `127.0.0.1:18089`
  (local Windows client, manual macOS SSH tunnel preview, or Linux x64 client under WSL2); `v0.7.0-qwen38-5090-beta.6` (source
  `e0971faf` on `Neroued/ninfer` master `64d10fbf`, image `7a19576b`, server `dc86e101`), profile
  `qwen38-5090-v0.13.0` (config `751d22dc`, kept from v0.13.0), model container v3 `81f924d4` (20.4 GB, served model ID `q38-ninfer`), DFlash2 draft window
  7, BF16 KV (146,368 automatic tokens), 131,072-token context, two requests in flight, schema 3
  checkpoints (isolated host `checkpoints-v017` mounted at `/checkpoints-v013`, strict origin auth, bounded resume/fresh admission, byte-proven durable-generation Host reclaim, non-blocking export), JSON-schema output,
  128-character tool names, vision + tools.
- **RTX 4090 and RTX 3090 native Windows 11 lanes:** `v0.8.0-qwen38-4090-beta.2` (package
  `d9b10b47`, server `ffee91bf`, profile `qwen38-4090-native-v0.8.0-beta.2`, config `ae27dc44`,
  one active request / `C1`, 30 s pending timeout, 15,747.734375 MiB shared Host budget, 640 MiB
  admission headroom) and `v0.8.0-qwen38-3090-beta.2` (package `97a8e634`, server `15a4db46`, profile
  `qwen38-3090-native-v0.8.0-beta.2`, config `238ccad7`, two requests in flight / `C2` over one
  shared 131,072-token pool, 180 s pending timeout, `ninfer-native-3090: 2` in `examples/manual-tunnel/fail-closed.yml`,
  20,867.734375 MiB shared Host budget, 768 MiB admission headroom, 350 W serving cap;
  `Install-Release.ps1` upgrades running or stopped `v0.8.0-qwen38-{4090,3090}-beta.1` lanes directly and preserves
  them for rollback, closing [#94](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-ninfer/issues/94))
  on loopback `127.0.0.1:18082`, carried unchanged at `a87de361` source on `Neroued/ninfer` master
  `64d10fbf`, UUID-bound on one two-GPU host (sequential single-GPU serving, one lane at a time),
  shared model container v3 `81f924d4` (20.4 GB, `qwen3_8_27b-v3.ninfer`; served model IDs
  `qwen3.8-27b` on RTX 4090 and `q38-ninfer` on RTX 3090), DFlash2 draft window 7 (`K=7`,
  `proposal: "artifact-default"`, `Q4_G64_FP16` draft MLP, host-mapped `token_embedding`), INT8 KV,
  `Group64` A8 and FP32 head logits off, 131,072-token context, 1,024-token prefill chunk, two extra
  device-state slots, schema 3 checkpoints (`session-checkpoints-v3`, strict origin auth),
  JSON-schema output, 128-character tool names, SPDX + CycloneDX dependency SBOMs, text + tools (no vision).
- **Proof:** Fresh v0.17.0 acceptance on frozen candidate commit `076bbe4f` across five documented routes
  (31 steps), all three stock Oh My Pi 18.18.6 client binaries (macOS arm64 preview, Windows x64, Linux x64
  under WSL2), and RTX 4090 native Windows public install, C1 fleet probe, and independent restoration
  (owner-operated, 408.213 s RTX 5090 hold, 508.420 s RTX 4090 window; RTX 3090's post-route
  `native-probes` automatic-compaction campaign failed at a 900 s timeout with 8 HTTP 503 queue
  timeouts, 2 HTTP 499 cancellations, and 3 sessions refused at subsequent managed Stop
  `graceful_incomplete_shutdown`, founder-waived with disclosure and empty-session Start/Stop
  lead recovery; no RTX 3090 behavior completion, structured outage, wrapper restoration audit pass,
  or anonymous public-install claim); RTX 5090 runtime qualification is fresh at `e0971faf` (181.92
  tok/s server decode and 56.63 s cold exact 130,048-token retrieval) and native Windows `beta.2`
  runtime qualifications are carried at `a87de361` (RTX 4090 254.59 tok/s C1 decode and 83.54 s exact
  retrieval; RTX 3090 148.70 tok/s C1 decode and 188.94 s exact retrieval; native no-regression speed
  gates vs published `beta.1`: RTX 3090 weighted 1.0003 / min 0.9988, 84/84 identical; RTX 4090
  weighted 0.9996 / min 0.9989, 115/115 identical).

## Release authorities

- [Release manifest](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-ninfer/blob/v0.17.0/releases/v0.17.0/manifest.json): exact client, runtime, model, and profile pins
- [Release notes](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-ninfer/blob/v0.17.0/releases/v0.17.0/NINFER_RELEASE_NOTES.md): release composition, client SHA-256 digests, acceptance, and support boundaries
- [Tagged quickstart](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-ninfer/blob/v0.17.0/docs/QUICKSTART.md): immutable installation guide for the current release
